newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-CLASSIC CLICHE HEADS FOR ARC AFTER ALL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-CLASSIC CLICHE HEADS FOR ARC AFTER ALL.

text.p: Classic Cliche, the mount of Frankie Dettori, will run in Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Doubts had persisted about the Ascot Gold Cup winner after he failed to sparkle in training at the weekend.
But Simon Crisford, racing manager for the Godolphin team, said on Thursday: "He runs for certain unless anything goes wrong between now and Sunday.
"At no stage was he unhealthy. He has just been a bit lacklustre in his attitude, but he has recaptured his sparkle lately."
With Dettori confirmed to partner 8-1 chance Classic Cliche, trainer John Gosden has booked three-times Arc winner Freddie Head to ride 16-1 outsider Tamure.
Dettori would have switched to Tamure if Classic Cliche, last year's St Leger winner, had been withdrawn.
Tamure, second in the 1995 Epsom Derby, has not run since finishing fourth in the Breeders' Cup Turf at Belmont Park last October, suffering an interrupted preparation during the summer.
